integrity_notes: All identities are derived analytically from the first-order conditions, Brownian conditional variance, and direct integration. The result is a specialized benchmark; no independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact identity for a scalar quadratic extended mean-field control benchmark with uncontrolled Brownian diffusion, deterministic initial state, time-independent cost, and unbounded action set. It does not imply a universal rate for general extended mean-field control or bounded controls.
title: An exact Brownian mesh-error law for a quadratic extended mean-field control problem
